message: Channel "alerts" credential is not a secret reference.
fix: Replace the literal with a reference: "${ENV_VAR}" (env substitution) or "op://vault/item/field" (1Password). core-contract never resolves the value; it only validates the reference syntax (REQ-SECR-03).

message: Estate timezone "Not/AZone" is not a valid IANA time zone.
fix: Use a canonical IANA zone name such as "America/Chicago" or "UTC".

message: Routing override for severity "critical" references channel "ghost-channel", which is not declared.
fix: Declare a channel named "ghost-channel", or correct routing_overrides[0].channels[0] to an existing channel name.

message: Service "api" references host "ghost-host", which is not declared.
fix: Declare a host named "ghost-host", or correct services[0].host to an existing host name.
Add a "rationale:" explaining why this is deliberately silenced — a silence without a reason is a validation error (charter §invariant 6).
